prompts.text: Use the two uploaded photos. The person in the first image is on the LEFT and the person in the second image is on the RIGHT: do not blend the two people. Show them as a romantic couple, close together: cheek to cheek, in a hug, or one resting the head on the other's shoulder, from the chest up, both faces turned toward the camera or three-quarters to it. Each keeps the face, hair, skin tone and clothes from their own photo. Black background: the whole background is pure, solid black, with no room, no wall, no furniture, no sky and no objects. Backlit subject contours (hair light / rim light), warm-toned backlight casts a bright warm glow on the edges, faces stay softly dim, but every face stays clear and recognizable, minimal vibe, strong light-and-shadow contrast. Light outlines the hair, translucent rim light, subject fades into darkness, high contrast, clean and minimalist, romantic mood. Place a simple filled small white heart emoji in the empty space above their heads. Photorealistic photo, vertical 9:16, like a real photo taken at night with one warm light behind them. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no other emoji, no frame. Exactly two people in the frame.
